description: Use when the person wants one of FilmLab's built-in flow templates (Only a Dream; One Figure, Five Worlds; Weird Summer) laid over the shots of a scene, or asks which templates exist. Each template is the same chain for every shot: a prompt node lays the template's rule on the shot's prompt (lab_prompt_transform with a custom instruction), then an image from that prompt, then a clip from that image with the start-image check on (the run stops until the person approves the start image). Without `vorlage_id` it lists the templates (name, description, the rule, the tools per shot, the clip length); with `vorlage_id` alone it returns that one. With `vorlage_id` and `shots` it builds the workflow the FilmLab app builds for a scene run: `shots` are ALL shots of the scene in scene order — `scene_ref` is `sb_` plus the shot's `scene_number` from the project's shot list, `hat_clip: true` marks a shot that already has a clip (it is not built again but stays context for the shots after it). This tool costs nothing, generates nothing and needs no account. Next step: pass the returned `workflow` UNCHANGED to lab_flow_angebot with the project id, name the price to the person and wait for their yes, then call lab_flow_starten with the same `workflow` and the angebot_id.

shots.description: ALL shots of the scene in scene order; only the shots without hat_clip are built

beschreibung.description: The shot's description — read as context for the shots after it, before the prompt

hat_clip.description: true: the shot already has a clip — not built again, still context for the shots after it

location_id.description: Location board of the shot's place (lab_list_project_locations); image and clip are anchored to it

prompt.description: The shot's prompt (its shot prompt in the shot list)

scene_ref.description: sb_ plus the shot's scene_number from the project's shot list

szene.description: The scene the shots belong to

ort.description: Where the scene plays — context for every prompt node

titel.description: Scene title — context for every prompt node, and part of the workflow name

vorlage_id.description: Template id from the list (call without arguments to see them)

name: lab_flow_vorlagen
title: Built-in Flow Templates
